about: Facts confirmed by building scripts in the Jellycuts iOS app and reading its console. Hand-maintained: only add an entry backed by a console result, and add the script to test/fixtures/app-console/. This file wins over the docs and the open-source compiler. scripts/build-catalog.mjs merges enumSpellings into data/catalog.json; src/jelly/validate.ts reads dictionaryParams.
